annotations.title: Today's card for a known product id

description: The same card as find_best_price and the website's product page /{locale}/p/{product}, for a product id you already hold (`product.slug` / `product.variant.id` from search_products, find_best_price or product_variants), without reading a query: no risk of landing on another variant. `product.variant` names the variant (storage, colour, model words, connectivity, size, `family_id` shared by its siblings). Answers from stored prices with the rule-based verdict; every offer carries `source_name`, `captured_at`, `blockers`, and the card `reasons` and `warnings`. An unknown id is `error.code` not_found. Next: product_variants for the other capacities or colours, price_history for the trend.

ai.description: Also run the shops live and let the model write the verdict (slower). Default false: stored prices and the rules.

deliver_to_country.description: Where the buyer wants delivery (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default: the first compared country.

include_shipping.description: Same as sort=total: count shipping in the order (the website's "Zahrnout dopravu"). Default false.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

product.description: Product slug (the stable product id), e.g. apple-iphone-16-128-gb.

sort.description: Order of `offers` and the price `best` is chosen by: product = lowest product price (the default; every offer still carries its shipping and total), total = lowest total with shipping to `deliver_to_country`. The card says which in `sort`; `cheapest_total` is the lowest total either way.

verified_only.description: Only shops with a customer rating.
